hill_rationale: Per Hill (2020, Ch.11), the client exhibits two readiness markers: explicit contradiction between an objectively strong academic record and the belief of not being 'actually smart'; and ambivalence between wanting to apply to PhD programs and the belief that doing so would be pointless.
